steps.en: Install QGIS from the official binaries (LTR or Latest Release)
steps.zh: 用官方安装包装 QGIS（LTR 或最新版）

steps.en: Drag shapefiles, GeoTIFFs, or a PostGIS connection into a new project
steps.zh: 把 shapefile、GeoTIFF 或 PostGIS 连接拖进新工程

steps.en: Reprojects every layer on the fly into the project CRS and renders your symbology
steps.zh: 把每个图层实时重投影到工程坐标系，并按你的符号渲染

steps.en: Run an analysis algorithm from the GUI toolbox, or headless from a terminal
steps.zh: 在工具箱里跑分析算法，或在终端无界面调用

steps.en: Exports the map as print-ready PDF/SVG, or serves the same project live as WMS/WFS via QGIS Server
steps.zh: 把地图导出为印刷级 PDF/SVG 或在线 WMS/WFS 服务

value.en: A pile of raw GIS files becomes a print-ready map — and a live web service — without leaving one application
value.zh: 一堆原始地理文件，在同一个应用里变成印刷级地图，还能直接变成在线服务
